For floating-point significance metrics (PValue, FDR), I used a very small tolerance of 1e-6 to allow negligible rounding differences. For inclusion levels and inclusion-level difference, which are proportion-scale quantities on roughly a 0-1 range, I used a tolerance of 0.01 as a standard practical threshold for percentage-like values.
